recipe.visualDefinition: A profile portrait of a man with a textured 80s-style haircut, set against a hazy, atmospheric blue background with a high-contrast magenta garment. The composition features bold vertical serif lettering on the left and a fluid, hand-drawn script signature in the lower right.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical text balancing the profile gaze
Complementary blue background vs magenta clothing
Soft-focus photographic grain vs sharp graphic overlays
High-key rim lighting on hair texture
coreInvariants: Vertical text alignment on the left margin
Script signature with a heart motif

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large profile portrait occupying the center and right, facing left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The vertical gold lettering on the left edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the vertical text, follows the subject's gaze downward, and finishes at the script signature in the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Atmospheric blue space around the head and behind the vertical text.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant magenta/red for the subject's clothing.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Gold/yellow for the vertical text and heart icon.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the clothing, muted tones in the skin and background, high value in the rim lighting.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif and fluid monoline script.
letterConstructionRules: Vertical text uses high-contrast slab serifs with drop shadows.
Signature text uses a continuous, monolinear cursive stroke.
Integration of a simple geometric heart shape within the script.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Stacked vertical orientation for the display text.
Extended swashes on the script signature.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of rigid, vertical slab serifs with organic, horizontal script.

avoid: Horizontal alignment for the primary title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serif weight and structure.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a profile portrait of a man with a voluminous 80s textured haircut and a shaved line detail, wearing a high-collar magenta jacket. The background should be a hazy, grainy blue with soft light leaks. The lighting should be a bright white rim light on the hair.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add vertical stacked text in a bold gold slab serif font on the left. Add a white monoline script signature in the bottom right, overlapping the jacket, including a simple gold heart outline.

verificationChecks: Is the text stacked vertically on the left?
Is the background a textured, hazy blue?
Does the signature include a heart icon?
Is the subject in a clear side profile?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the vertical text is legible and properly spaced.
Verify the rim light creates a halo effect on the hair.
Check that the script signature looks hand-drawn, not typed.
Confirm the color palette maintains the blue/magenta/gold triad.
recipe.reuseFormula: Profile portrait + Hazy blue background + Vertical Slab Serif (Left) + Script Signature (Bottom Right) + 80s Grain.
